name: [Kasir][Happy path] Cash sale reduces stock and the receipt matches the paid total
description: A cashier with an open shift sells one unit of a test product for cash; its stock drops by exactly one and the receipt total equals the total shown before payment.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search the product list for 'BAUT L SOLO' and note the stock shown on its product card
Click the BAUT L SOLO product card once to add one unit to the cart
Note the grand total shown in the cart
Open the payment dialog
Choose cash as the payment method and enter an amount exactly equal to the grand total
Finish the transaction
Verify the success dialog shows a receipt number and the same grand total noted in the cart
Start a new transaction from the success dialog
Search the product list for 'BAUT L SOLO' again
Verify the BAUT L SOLO product card now shows a stock exactly one lower than the number noted before the sale

name: [Kasir][Validasi] Cash tendered below the total cannot finish the sale
description: A cash payment smaller than the grand total must be blocked with clear feedback.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search for 'PRIMA GA3' and add one unit to the cart
Open the payment dialog and choose cash
Enter a cash amount of 1
Verify the finish button in the payment dialog is disabled or clicking it shows a message that the cash is not enough, and no success dialog with a receipt number appears

name: [Kasir][Logika][POS-01][POS-02] Tempo sale with a down payment records the DP and the remaining receivable
description: A credit (tempo) sale with a cash down payment must store the DP; the receipt must show the DP and the remaining receivable, not a full cash payment.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search for 'KOVIN PLUS' and add it to the cart
Set the KOVIN PLUS cart quantity to 6 so the grand total is above 20000
Select the customer 'UJI Pelanggan Tempo' in the customer field
Open the payment dialog and choose the tempo (credit) payment method
Set the due date to 30 days from today
Enter 10000 in the cash field that the dialog describes as the down payment (Uang Muka / DP)
Finish the transaction
Open the printable receipt from the success dialog
Verify the receipt shows a down payment of Rp 10.000 and a remaining receivable equal to the grand total minus 10.000, and it does NOT show a cash (TUNAI) amount equal to the full grand total

name: [Kasir][Validasi][POS-03] Tempo sale without a customer is refused
description: A credit sale with no customer to collect from must be blocked.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Make sure the customer field is empty
Search for 'PRIMA GA3' and add one unit to the cart
Open the payment dialog and choose the tempo (credit) payment method
Try to finish the transaction
Verify an error tells the cashier to choose a customer, and no success dialog with a receipt number appears

name: [Kasir][Logika][POS-12] Choosing a customer without a price tier resets a previous Grosir selection
description: If the cashier first picks the Grosir price type and then picks a customer that has no price tier, the cart must fall back to the standard retail price.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Create a new customer from the cashier screen named 'UJI Tanpa Grup' with phone 080000000013 and no customer type
Clear the customer field
Change the customer/price type selector to Grosir
Search for 'GIBGRO' and add one unit to the cart, then note its unit price
Select the customer 'UJI Tanpa Grup'
Verify the price type selector now shows the standard (Umum / Standar) type and the GIBGRO cart line unit price equals Rp 5.000, the normal retail selling price

name: [Kasir][Integritas data][POS-09] Double-clicking finish creates only one sale
description: Two fast clicks on the finish button must produce one receipt and one stock deduction.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search for 'PRIMA BLACK 15GR*10*100' and note the stock shown on its product card
Add that product to the cart once
Open the payment dialog, choose cash, and use the exact-amount (uang pas) option
Double-click the finish button quickly
Start a new transaction from the success dialog
Search for 'PRIMA BLACK 15GR*10*100' again
Verify its product card shows a stock exactly one lower than before, not two lower

name: [Kasir][UI/UX][POS-18] F9 opens the payment dialog as its button label promises
description: The checkout button is labeled 'Pembayaran (F9)'; pressing F9 with items in the cart should open the payment dialog.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If the cashier screen is locked by the open-shift dialog, open a shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search for 'PRIMA GA3' and add one unit to the cart
Press the F9 key
Verify the payment dialog is open and shows the cart grand total and a button to finish the transaction

name: [Kasir][Alur kerja] Closing a shift shows opening cash plus cash sales and locks the cashier screen
description: After a cash sale, the close-shift dialog's expected cash equals opening cash plus cash sales; once closed, the cashier cannot add items until a new shift is opened.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
If a shift is already open, close it by entering the expected cash shown in the close-shift dialog
Open a new shift with an opening cash amount of 100000
Search for 'BAUT L SOLO', add one unit, and finish the sale with cash at the exact amount; note the grand total
Start a new transaction from the success dialog
Open the close-shift dialog
Verify the expected cash in the close-shift dialog equals 100000 plus the noted grand total
Enter that expected cash as the counted cash and confirm closing the shift
Verify the cashier screen is locked again by the open-shift dialog and products cannot be added to the cart
